items.title: On Being Asked What Was the "Origin of Love"

items.titleIt: Null
items.excerpt:
The "Origin of Love!"--Ah, why
That cruel question ask of me,
When thou mayst read in many an eye
He starts to life on seeing thee?
And shouldst thou seek his _end_ to know:
My heart forebodes, my fears foresee,
He'll linger long in silent woe;
But live until--I cease to be.

items.summary: Nikolai Kulikovsky fu il secondo marito della Granduchessa Olga Alexandrovna, sorella dello zar Nicola II e figlia di Alessandro III. Proveniva da una famiglia militare proprietaria terriera del sud dell'Impero Russo, seguendo la tradizione familiare entrando nell'esercito. La loro relazione iniziò con un incontro durante una revisione militare nel 1903.
items.excerpt: Nikolai Alexandrovich Kulikovsky was the second husband of Grand Duchess Olga Alexandrovna of Russia, the sister of Tsar Nicholas II and daughter of Tsar Alexander III. He was born into a military landowning family from the south of the Russian Empire, and followed the family tradition by entering the army.

Un evento sociale organizzato dalla famiglia reale.
